_comment: T070 (docs/changes/T070-T006-2406.md): every route of the legacy Hikvision NVR Panel 1.5.27 (docs/legacy/legacy_surface_v1.5.27.json) is claimed by exactly one capability here; scripts/legacy_parity.py check verifies the claims against contracts/API_INVENTORY.md, the evidence files and the Arx add-on config. Routes are 'METHOD path' exactly as the inventory / the legacy decorators write them. Statuses: same / better / partial / replaced / missing / dropped (definitions in the script). `lab` names the LAB items of the migration plan that prove the row on the owner's installation.

capabilities.capability: Sign-in: shared PIN, technician PIN, session cookie
capabilities.arx_surface: Home Assistant identity (Ingress) + Settings > users and permissions
capabilities.notes: one HA user per person, role AND scope per binding (HA_IDENTITY_RBAC_HE.md); REUSE_MATRIX row 19

capabilities.capability: Public UI configuration (PIN length, snapshot interval, go2rtc Ingress path, display offset)
capabilities.notes: per-installation settings + the caller's own permissions; nothing about go2rtc reaches the browser

capabilities.capability: Recording display offset (auto / manual / auto+manual)
capabilities.notes: no offset: NVR wall-clock times converted per instant with the IANA zone (time.zone); KNOWN_QUIRKS T1/T2/T5

capabilities.capability: NVR connection: read, save, test
capabilities.notes: tested before it is saved, password encrypted and never returned (the legacy GET returned the stored NVR password to any PIN holder); CR-022

capabilities.capability: Camera display names (aliases), rename
capabilities.notes: migrated by scripts/migrate_legacy.py --apply-aliases (empty Arx aliases only; VMS-local write, audited)

capabilities.capability: Raw ISAPI GET proxy for any signed-in user
capabilities.decision: security: no raw device proxy in the product (spec chapter 32; REUSE_MATRIX row 27)

capabilities.capability: Camera snapshot (3 URL fallbacks)
Channel status (online / offline)
Camera (IPC) reboot through the NVR
capabilities.decision: OPEN - owner question T070-Q2 (recommendation: accept the gap; a physical action, rarely used, rebuild only on request behind a sensitive permission)

capabilities.capability: NVR reboot
capabilities.notes: behind nvr.system.reboot with a typed second confirmation, audited

capabilities.capability: Storage: disk list and deep status
capabilities.notes: disks, retention measured vs estimated, S.M.A.R.T. read-only

capabilities.capability: Disk tests: S.M.A.R.T. and bad sectors
capabilities.notes: S.M.A.R.T. test behind nvr.storage.test; no bad-sector test (an hours-long device write) - not requested since

capabilities.capability: Maintenance aggregate (device, channels, storage, capabilities, tracks)
capabilities.notes: separate health states per subsystem instead of one blob (chapter 30)

capabilities.capability: Manual recording: status, start (with auto-stop), stop
capabilities.notes: an NVR write behind nvr.record.manual; legacy rows are NOT migrated - a running legacy manual recording is stopped in the legacy UI before the cutover

capabilities.capability: Events: list, live, search (disabled in production by EVENTS_ENABLED = False)
capabilities.notes: the legacy screen was switched off; Arx stores NVR alerts + recording-derived + HA sensor events

capabilities.capability: Picture search and event picture (disabled with the events)
capabilities.notes: no NVR picture search; event thumbnails instead (the legacy feature never ran in production)

capabilities.capability: Recording tracks, record profile, search profile
capabilities.notes: track discovery instead of the <ch>01 formula (KNOWN_QUIRKS S7); REUSE_MATRIX row 4

capabilities.capability: Recorded days per month (daily distribution chips)
capabilities.decision: OPEN - owner question T070-Q3 (recommendation: accept for the cutover, add a month view of recorded days later as its own small card)

capabilities.capability: Recording search (paged, deduplicated) and the timeline
capabilities.notes: coverage / partial reporting, the IANA zone, one search per NVR at a time (KNOWN_QUIRKS S2)

capabilities.capability: MP4 download of a recording (ISAPI download by file)
capabilities.notes: durable jobs, remux of the Hikvision PS container, hash, retention

capabilities.capability: Live view: go2rtc stream create, list, WebSocket relay
capabilities.notes: smplwise_ namespace only, per-camera authorization on the relay, no credentials in stream names

capabilities.capability: Playback: a go2rtc stream per click (no in-stream seek)
capabilities.notes: session + seek generations, ordered cleanup, time to media measured (T074); the media anchor is T006

capabilities.capability: Generic go2rtc HTTP proxy (any method, CORS *)
capabilities.decision: security: only the signalling / MSE / snapshot paths Arx owns are exposed (REUSE_MATRIX row 10)

capabilities.capability: Live RTSP URL with credentials to the browser (the RTSP copy button)
capabilities.decision: security: credentials never reach the browser (REUSE_MATRIX row 28)

capabilities.capability: The single-page UI (Ingress panel 'NVR')
capabilities.arx_surface: Arx Ingress panel (smplwise_vms/www), RTL Hebrew, desktop / tablet / mobile
capabilities.notes: live grid 1-16 with ordering, single player main/sub, timeline and themes rebuilt (REUSE_MATRIX rows 22-25)
